newsitem.title: NICARAGUA: Nicaragua inflation 0.02 percent in January.
newsitem.headline: Nicaragua inflation 0.02 percent in January.

text.p: Nicaraguan prices rose by 0.02 percent in January, with falling food costs keeping inflation close to zero, Nicaragua's Central Bank reported on Monday.
Inflation over the past 12 months totaled 11.4 percent, with prices in January 1995 rising by 0.72 percent.

The monthly cost of basic goods -- food, clothing and household products for a family of six -- fell by 6.86 cordobas ($0.76) in January for a total of 1,300.3 cordobas ($144.18), fed by lower food prices, the Central Bank said.
State workers such as teachers and nurses earn about $60 per month.
